scope: Props/environment only. Human parts and approved UI excluded.

acceptance.rule: Acceptance is style approval only; new batches and Unity product suitability require review. Accepted PNG may be viewed for evaluation but never used as generation input.

reference_policy: Only original user-provided style reference/sample images. ALL previous generation results prohibited as positive/negative references, edit targets or supporting inputs. No num_last_images_to_include.
style_contract_verbatim:
AUTHORITATIVE STYLE: match the two supplied ORIGINAL references' overall visual identity: shape, proportions, projection, outline, palette restraint, shading structure, and detail density together. The images show compact low-resolution orthographic 2D raster furniture with concise rectangular forms, screen-axis aligned horizontal/vertical lines, thin consistent dark gray/black contours and restrained planar shading. Create objects that belong naturally alongside those actual sample assets. Do not merely borrow a color or texture. Do not reproduce sample object lists, modern equipment, people, icons, sheet layout or opaque checkerboard.
SHAPE: simple geometry, straight lines and simple curves, slim frames and corners, no bulges, bulky bedposts, decorative projections or unnecessary depth. Clearly separate functional parts, but prioritize recognition at small game size. No extra structural detail to showcase texture.
PROJECTION: the samples' orthographic top-down/front hybrid. Use the functional face for each object: tabletop/bed/chest upper plane readable, upright pieces with minimal necessary front-plane cues. Horizontal and vertical axes parallel to screen. Keep side thickness to minimum. No perspective convergence, isometric skew, diagonal staging, photorealistic furniture showcase or 3D-render volume. Maintain the reference's view logic across objects.
LINES: thin uniform SINGLE dark gray/black outline. External and internal structural lines nearly equal width. No irregular thick corner rims, doubled black outlines, exterior drop shadows, colored bleed, ragged brush-painted edges. Texture/shading stays strictly INSIDE boundaries, never distorts contour.
SURFACE: preserve reference-level color/material separation. Stable large base-color regions with only subtle internal fine texture: soft woodgrain and tiny color differences, restrained metal highlight/tonal variation, soft cloth folds and fine fiber suggestion. No dense scratch/grain noise, photoreal microdetail or dominant painterly brushwork. Material refinement must not change shape or overall style.
COLOR/LIGHT: restrained saturation and reference-level contrast, diffuse lighting with NO strong direction. Only construction joints and shallow steps may have relatively darker shadows. Avoid deep shadows, strong volumetric contrast and glossy/plastic gradients. Highlights only enough for material identity.
RASTER: reference-like low-resolution 2D raster expression, mild antialiasing, compact readable details. Not razor-sharp vector illustration, hard stair-step pixel art, sticker/chibi cartoon or a highly detailed painted illustration.
LAYOUT: six isolated sprites, one per conceptual 512x512 cell, full silhouettes inside canvas, at least32px clear margin and generous empty separation. TRUE transparent background, no baked checkerboard, backdrop, ambient color clouds, cast-shadow clouds, labels, caption, watermark or frame. Do not fill empty canvas with anything. This is review-only, not an in-game screenshot.
variation_policy: Reuse the accepted style clauses verbatim; change requested object list only for current 6-cell expansion batches. Do not introduce a new style adjective, decorative era or lighting direction. Future format changes must preserve the style contract and be recorded explicitly.

preserved_structure.sprite_sheet: Separate requested sprites only; preserve requested canvas, grid/cell order, object count, generous transparent padding, non-overlap, stable names/IDs and consistent relative scale. No added labels, watermark, display board or environment.
preserved_structure.alpha: Isolated sprites and parts require genuine transparent surroundings, clean alpha and no baked checkerboard, colored halo or backdrop. Opaque repeating surface tiles remain opaque where the existing technical brief requires them.
preserved_structure.parts: Preserve existing detached parts, attachment pivots and assembly relationships. Characters keep Head / Body / Hand and the approved legless topology; do not add limbs, merge parts or invent equipment.
preserved_structure.views: Preserve the specified top-down/near-orthographic view and existing direction order, anchors, registration, scale and alignment. A stylistic reference does not authorize importing its perspective.
preserved_structure.tiles: Preserve connection endpoints, dimensions, edge/corner/transition coverage and repeat boundaries. Test seamless surfaces in a 3x3 repeat and modular pieces in valid adjacency combinations.
preserved_structure.partition_wall: Keep each native segment at Transform scale (1,1,1), repeat N connected segments and use one collision shape per straight connected wall run. Native size is determined by source proportions and explicit PPU; never compensate with nonuniform Transform scaling.

validation.style: Compare actual output with user original samples and accepted result for evaluation only: silhouettes, proportions, orthographic hybrid view, thin single contour, restrained palette/contrast, subtle interior texture, diffuse light and raster detail density. No stylistic acceptance from prompt text alone.
validation.technical: Check actual dimensions, item count, nonoverlap, alpha/background composites, sprite boundaries and relevant seams/module adjacencies before product use. Grid cells are review arrangement, not defined world sizes.
validation.acceptance: New candidate outputs require user consistency review; no automatic P2 completion.

legacy_policy: Historical prompts/results retained unchanged as provenance, never active generation references. This B contract supersedes earlier Painterly style emphasis, generated EDIT_TARGET and negative-image instructions.
execution: Prompt source data only, not an executing generation/import engine.
